rubric.evidence: WebIDL verbatim from Web Machine Learning CG Translator API spec and Writing Assistance APIs supporting types (fetched 2026-11-24), cross-checked with Blink translator.idl/cc. Concrete Android guardrails (TranslationAPIMaxServiceCount=2 vs 10, TranslationAPIModelIdleUnloadTimeout=1m vs 0, TranslationAPIMaxInputSizeBytes=256 KiB vs 0, ~79-84 MiB per pair) quoted directly from Chromium components/on_device_translation/features.cc and ChromeStatus 5106126157905920.

Feature 5106126157905920 appears under 'Enabled by default' in /api/v0/features?milestone=161 with listing name 'Translator API on Android'; slug translator-api-on-android matches listing name; H1 equals listing name; declared ChromeStatus row links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5106126157905920.

Full reference justified under invariant #6 because MDN's Translator page does not document Android Custom Tabs, Android memory/input/metered-network guardrails, or TranslatorAPIAllowed on Android, and BCD still lists chrome_android: false. reference-contract.json maps all 5 inventory items across all 9 required dimensions.

Explains the full Translator lifecycle alongside Android-specific operational realities (chunking for the 256 KiB input cap, calling destroy() under the 2-service cap, why inputQuota returning Infinity does not override Android's service byte budget, and why storage/metered-network checks return unavailable).

Embeds the verified live Chrome Platform Showcase concept demo (availability-states, which checks availability without auto-downloading models), links all 4 sibling v161 concept demos, and provides two complete semantic <pre><code> examples (Android-safe chunked translation with cleanup and translateStreaming).

Combines BCD api/Translator.json (Chrome desktop 138, Edge 148, Firefox/Safari false), ChromeStatus 5106126157905920 (Chrome Android 161, WebView null), webstatus.dev Limited availability, and Mozilla/WebKit standards-positions while explicitly disclosing BCD's chrome_android: false freshness gap.

Every visible source label carries a direct <a href> with target='_blank' rel='noopener' (W3C/CG specs, Blink IDL/C++, Chromium features.cc, Enterprise policy, BCD, webstatus.dev, ChromeStatus, blink-dev, crbug, wpt.fyi, MDN, CPS).

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2/h3 headings, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, captioned semantic tables with <th scope>, focusable .table-wrap scroll regions with aria-labelledby and :focus-visible outline, descriptive iframe title, and role='note' on the Baseline banner.

Uses shared public/styles.css semantic tokens, logical max-inline-size: 100% on .table-wrap horizontal scrollers, max-width: 100% on the lazy-loaded CPS iframe, and verified via npm run responsive at desktop (1280x800) and narrow mobile (360x740).
